statements.statement: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and a sensation of rapid heart rate
There is clinical suspicion for supraventricular tachycardia
The service was ordered to capture the arrhythmia during symptomatic events and guide further management
The diagnosis codes I47.1 and R00.2 were submitted
The denial reason code is CO-97
The denial is based on the service being bundled into another covered procedure
